title: RIPR Cache Export
description: The document `ripr cache export --out NEW_DIRECTORY` writes to stdout, with exit code 0, after it copied and validated a current-input cache snapshot into the new directory. A failed export writes no JSON: it exits 2 with prose on stderr. `schema_version` versions this report, not the copied cache layers.

cache_dir.description: The export directory as an absolute path in the host's own spelling: `--out` resolved against the working directory, with its parent canonicalized.

classified_entries.description: Classified-seam cache families copied for the current inputs: the full family, the compact family, or both. An export with none refuses instead of succeeding.

file_fact_entries.description: Per-file fact entries copied for the current inputs.

missing_file_facts.description: Current input files with no file fact entry to copy. File facts are optional, so a missing one is counted, not refused.

copied_files.description: Files written to the export, including sharded manifests and the shards they reference; at least `classified_entries` plus `file_fact_entries`.

logical_file_bytes.description: The sum of the copied files' encoded lengths. It does not describe allocated bytes, directory overhead or peak disk use.
